services.desc: SMYRNA, Tenn. - Boater Brian Carper of Murfreesboro, Tennessee, caught five bass Saturday weighing 17 pounds, 12 ounces, to win the MLF Phoenix Bass Fishing League Presented by T-H Marine on Percy Priest Lake. The tournament was the second event for the Bass Fishing League Music City Division. blurb: When you put down your hard earned money for a day of fishing, it should be YOUR DAY. We don’t keep our best spots to ourselves and let you settle for the leftovers. We don’t believe that you should be charged the outrageous prices that are the norm these days in the guiding business. We treat our customers like friends. Your total satisfaction is all we’re concerned with, and we put our money where our mouth is.
